content: प्रस्तुत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Praised, eulogized. .²2 Begun, commenced. .²3 Accomplished, done, effected. .²4 Happened. .²5 Approached. .²6 Proposed, declared, under discussion, taken in hand. .²7 Expected, desired. .²8 Ready, prepared. .²9 Executed with effort or energy. .²10 Made or consisting of. .{@-तम्@} .²1 The matter in hand, the subject under discussion or consideration; अपि स्मरति नः साधो गोविन्दः प्रस्तुते क्वचित् <ls>Bhāg. 10. 47. 42</ls>; अधुना प्रस्तुतमनुस्रियताम्. .²2 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) Forming the subject of discussion, the उपमेय; see प्रकृत; अप्रस्तुतप्रशंसा सा या सैव प्रस्तुताश्रया <ls>K. P. 10</ls>.
